annotations.text: Start with the cover: why nine rounds produced no pick, the floor decided from the owner's own reads, the three directions, the same boat in three hands, the side-by-side, the recommendation and the one call (H-87). Then the three boards in a row — each redraws the same six screens for Blue Mantis on Thursday, August 27 at 6:40 AM: the home and a boat on a desk; the home, the roll call, the night roll call and the storefront in a pocket. Compare the same screen across the three before reading any prose.

A · Inset: the group carries the page (Settings, Reminders, Health). B · Glass: the material carries the page (Photos, Maps, Safari). C · Figures: the number carries the page (Weather, Fitness, Health), on Inset's lists and shell. Recommended: C.
